title: Construction Performance Tolerances and One-Time Repair Allowances, HomeCare Programs
content:
Under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty, a crack is within tolerance when its width, or for flatwork its vertical displacement, is below the program's figure in inches, and drywall nail pops and caulk and grout touch-ups are repaired in a fixed number of one-time visits.

## Crack tolerances (inches)

| Program | Flatwork concrete crack width | Flatwork concrete vertical displacement | Foundation slab crack width | Brick or stone veneer crack width | Drywall crack width |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Standard | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.1875 | 0.375 | 0.125 |
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Select | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.1875 | 0.375 | 0.125 |
| HomeCare 1-3-10 Plus | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.1875 | 0.375 | 0.125 |
| HomeCare 2-3-10 Preferred | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.1875 | 0.375 | 0.125 |
| HomeCare 2-5-10 Premier | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.1875 | 0.375 | 0.125 |
| HomeCare 2-5-15 Reserve | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.1875 | 0.375 | 0.125 |

Each figure is the width (or, for flatwork, the vertical displacement) below which the crack is within tolerance. The tolerances are the same in every program.

## One-time repair visits included

| Program | Drywall nail pop repair visits (performed with the eleven-month walkthrough) | Caulk and grout touch-up visits |
|---|---|---|
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Standard | 1 | 1 |
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Select | 1 | 1 |
| HomeCare 1-3-10 Plus | 1 | 1 |
| HomeCare 2-3-10 Preferred | 1 | 1 |
| HomeCare 2-5-10 Premier | 2 | 2 |
| HomeCare 2-5-15 Reserve | 2 | 2 |

## Notes on the figures

- The only program difference in this facet is the number of one-time visits: HomeCare 2-5-10 Premier and HomeCare 2-5-15 Reserve include two of each, every other program one of each.
- Hypothetical illustration: a drywall crack measured at 0.10 inch sits below the 0.125 inch drywall figure, while a foundation slab crack measured at 0.20 inch is not below the 0.1875 inch slab figure.
